games.title: Danganronpa 2x2
facts: Launches 14 January 2027 in North America and Europe.
Coming to PS5, Xbox Series X|S, Switch 2, the original Switch and PC (Steam and Epic Games Store).
Published by Spike Chunsoft and developed by Gemdrops.
It is a remake of Danganronpa 2: Goodbye Despair (2012) with two modes, both open from the start.
Original mode is the 2012 story with updated visuals and presentation.
Slayhem is a new scenario on the same island with the same cast, but the murders and culprits are completely different.
You still explore in Daily Life, collect evidence as Truth Bullets in Investigations, and argue it out in fully voiced Class Trials.
A standard physical edition (Switch 2, Switch or PS5) and a limited Psycho Tropical Vacation Package with Monokuma and Monomi figures, a hat and the soundtrack. No prices have been given.

faq: Is Danganronpa 2x2 a remake?
Yes. It remakes Danganronpa 2: Goodbye Despair and adds Slayhem, a new scenario with different murders and culprits on the same island.
Do I need to play the original Danganronpa 2 first?
No. Original mode is the full 2012 story, so you can start there. Slayhem changes who dies and who did it, so it works best once you know the original.
Is Danganronpa 2x2 on Switch 1?
Yes. It is coming to the original Switch as well as Switch 2, PS5, Xbox Series X|S and PC on 14 January 2027.
Is there a Danganronpa 2x2 Japan release date?
Not on our list yet. The 14 January 2027 date is for North America and Europe.

games.title: Ananta
facts: Launches 15 January 2027 worldwide on PS5, PC, iOS and Android.
The date was announced with a trailer at Gamescom Opening Night Live in August 2026.
On PC you can play through Steam or the game's own launcher.
It is free-to-play. The developers said at Tokyo Game Show 2025 that there is no character gacha: you unlock characters by playing.
Made by Naked Rain, a NetEase studio with teams in Hangzhou and Montreal. NetEase Games publishes it.
Set in fictional cities inspired by Shanghai, Hangzhou and Tokyo. The first city is Nova City; a second city was shown with the date trailer.
You play a content creator who builds influence while helping keep the city safe.
Combat is martial arts mixed with the environment and improvised weapons.
You get around by car, motorbike, helicopter, boat and glider, and can switch between several playable characters.
Over 17 million players pre-registered across more than 110 countries and regions.
No Xbox or Switch 2 version has been announced.

faq: Is Ananta free to play?
Yes. Ananta is free-to-play on PS5, PC, iPhone and Android. The developers have said characters are unlocked by playing, not through a gacha.
Is Ananta coming to Xbox or Switch 2?
Not so far. It is announced for PS5, PC, iOS and Android only.
Is Ananta on Steam?
Yes. On PC it is coming to Steam, and it also has its own launcher.
Is Ananta a gacha game?
Not for characters. At Tokyo Game Show 2025 the team said there is no character gacha. How paid cosmetics will be sold has not been fully explained yet.
Is Ananta like GTA?

Partly. It is a modern open city with cars, helicopters and fights, but it is not a crime game: you play a content creator, and combat is martial arts. See our games like GTA 6 page for closer matches.
When was Ananta announced?
It was first shown in August 2023 as Project Mugen and renamed Ananta in December 2024. The 15 January 2027 date was announced in August 2026.

facts: Launches 15 January 2027 worldwide on PS5, Xbox Series X|S and PC (Steam and Microsoft Store).
Made by Ryu Ga Gotoku Studio and published by SEGA.
It is included in Xbox Game Pass, and it is an Xbox Play Anywhere game.
The story runs from 1915 to 1965 across five Japanese cities: Kokura, Kure, Osaka, Atami and Tokyo.
You play Makoto Daito, who stows away from San Francisco to Japan as a boy. The game mixes brawling with music and live shows.
Tupac Shakur appears as a character called Amaru, with his estate's permission. Snoop Dogg and Tori Kelly also voice characters.
Digital Standard and Deluxe editions, plus a physical Collector's Edition with a vinyl record and SteelBook. Pre-orders get a bonus weapon.
It is a single-player game. No Switch 2 version has been announced.

facts: Warhammer 40,000: Dark Heresy comes out on 28 January 2027 on PS5, Xbox Series X|S and PC.

Yes, but later. Owlcat confirmed a Switch 2 version after the 28 January 2027 launch on PS5, Xbox Series X|S and PC, with no date yet.
Is Dark Heresy turn-based?
Yes. Like Rogue Trader, it is a party-based CRPG with tactical turn-based combat.
Can I play the Dark Heresy beta?
Only on Steam, and only if you bought a Founder's Pack, Developer's Digital Pack or Collector's Edition. The beta closes on 7 January 2027.

No. It is a new game from the same studio, set in the Calixis Sector, where you play a member of the Inquisition instead of a Rogue Trader.

faq: Is Hyrule Warriors: Age of Calamity Definitive Edition a free upgrade?
No. It is a separate Switch 2 game. If you own the Switch 1 version you get a discount on the digital Switch 2 version through the eShop, and your save carries over.
How do I get the Switch 1 owner discount with a physical copy?

Nintendo says to insert the game card into a Switch 2, update the game, start it and choose Proceed to Nintendo eShop from the main menu. You need an internet connection. Digital owners get the discount on their Nintendo Account automatically.
Does the Definitive Edition include the DLC?
Yes. All Expansion Pass content is included, so there are 21 playable fighters instead of 18.
Is it on the original Switch?
No. The Definitive Edition is only for Switch 2. The original 2020 game stays on Switch 1.
Does it run at 60 fps?
Yes. Nintendo and the press coverage say it runs at 60 fps on Switch 2 with more enemies on screen.

It is a Nintendo Switch 2 exclusive, made by FromSoftware (Elden Ring, Bloodborne) in partnership with Nintendo.
Hidetaka Miyazaki, FromSoftware's president, is the director.
It is an online multiplayer game. Miyazaki calls it PvPvE: up to 8 players fight enemies and each other in the same match.
Most matches are last player standing. Some instead have players team up against a powerful boss, and Victory Points can be earned without direct combat.
You play as one of the Bloodsworn, people who gained superhuman powers from special blood. There are over a dozen characters to choose from, and every one has a ranged attack.
Maps have no fixed era. Nintendo has shown Gothic and Victorian-style places set near the end of the early modern period.
A Closed Network Test ran on Switch 2 from 21 to 23 August 2026 (US time). It needed an approved application and a Nintendo Switch Online membership.
No price, editions or pre-orders have been announced yet.

games.seo_title: The Duskbloods Release Date, Delay to 2027 and Switch 2 Details
games.qa_note: It was planned for 2026, but FromSoftware moved it to 2027 on 29 October 2026 to finish adjusting its game rules and balance. It is an online PvPvE game for up to 8 players.
games.sources: FromSoftware (official X post, via Shacknews 29 Oct 2026), Nintendo Creator's Voice interview (via RPG Site), VGC, Game Informer, GamingBolt, Kotaku
faq: Why was The Duskbloods delayed?
FromSoftware said it needed more time for final adjustments to the game rules and balancing, after its August 2026 network test. It moved the game from 2026 to 2027.
Is The Duskbloods coming to PS5, Xbox or PC?
No. It is only announced for Nintendo Switch 2, and FromSoftware and Nintendo call it a Switch 2 exclusive.
Is The Duskbloods Bloodborne 2?
No. It is a new game with its own Bloodsworn characters. Like Bloodborne it has Gothic and Victorian-style settings and firearms, but it is an online PvPvE game, not a single-player sequel.
Does The Duskbloods have single player?
No single-player mode has been announced. Miyazaki describes it as an online multiplayer focused game, and says FromSoftware will still make single-player games.
How many players can play The Duskbloods?
Up to 8 players in one online match.
Do I need Nintendo Switch Online to play The Duskbloods?
The 2026 network test needed Nintendo Switch Online. Nintendo has not said yet whether the full game will, but online play on Switch 2 normally does.
